Name: Control Panel
Description: Golem Control's web panel (HTTP). Put it behind AMP's or your own HTTPS reverse proxy if it faces the internet.

Name: Game Server WebRTC
Description: Game servers' direct WebRTC links when Cloudflare TURN is off (one UDP port per server process). Only open while players are connected, so 'Not listening' here is normal. With TURN on in Golem Control's Settings, servers use other ports and TURN instead, and these aren't needed.
